'''Slatblath''' was an [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and member of the [[Zargnor Clan]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Stop! We give up! No more blasting! Our big fight not with you!|Slatblath, begging mercy of the future [[Hunter (individual)|Grand Champion of the Great Hunt]]|<ref name="TOR:TU" />}}
In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_dates" /> Slatblath and his clan brothers [[Gornik]] and [[Ugmir]] participated to the [[Great Hunt (c. 3643 BBY)|Great Hunt]]. The Ugnaughts were known a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] in their hunts.<ref name="TOR:TU" />

{{GameDS}}
Slatblath was killed on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] along with Gornik and Ugmir by a [[Hunter (individual)|rival bounty hunter]] who was hunting the [[Eidolon (assassin)|same target]] as the trio.<ref name="TOR:TU" />
{{Endgame}}

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The player has the option of sparing Slatblath along with his clan brothers instead of killing them.<ref name="TOR:TU" />
